initialExam.title: Kerala Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Kerala Police Constable recruitment through Kerala PSC for constable posts in Kerala state police, armed police, and women police.
initialExam.eligibility: SSLC (10th pass) or Plus Two from a recognized board
initialExam.applicationFee: Nil (Kerala PSC does not charge application fee)
initialExam.syllabus: GK, Current Affairs, Kerala GK, Reasoning, Mathematics, English, Malayalam.
initialExam.examPattern: OMR/Online Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 75 minutes. Physical Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Efficiency Test → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit keralapsc.gov.in 2. One-time registration 3. Apply online 4. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension, Festival allowance
